reviews.title: 365 day streak — a retrospective
reviews.text:
Today marks the day I reach my 365 day medal streak on Cut The Rope Daily, so I thought I would share some of my experiences with this game.

I've been playing the game since a little after its initial launch, and I've been having a lot of fun with it during a really challenging last year of my life.

Being a Cut The Rope fan since the early 2010's, this game truly brings me back to the original days of ZeptoLab's innovative and original puzzle design. I genuinely miss the times when games didn't have ads or pop ups, so I'm really glad that ZeptoLab had the opportunity to work with Netflix Games to bring the series back to its golden years without having to monetize or add intrusive pay to win mechanics.

In a way, Cut The Rope Daily feels new and nostalgic at the same time, and this game means a whole heck of a lot to me, reminding me of my childhood. I play the new puzzles every day at night and I'm excited for the future of this game.

I would love to see more opportunities to get additional streak shields, which are a rare item only obtainable on holidays, since I've come very close to losing my streak when there are days I cannot play the game. Regardless, I've been having a lot of fun with the game.

Keep up the great work, ZeptoLab team!
